analyses.title: On the compactness of artificial compressibility approximations of weak solutions for fluid problems in deforming domains
analyses.abstract: In this contribution, a fluid flow problem on a general deforming domain for a Newtonian fluid in two and three space dimensions with artificial compressibility approximation is studied. We prove an estimate on the integral equicontinuity in time of the weak solutions under suitable domain regularity assumptions, which is independent on the compressibility parameter and serves as an alternative compactness argument for the convergence of weak solution sequences for vanishing compressibility. The corresponding estimate is obtained by remapping the problem onto a fixed reference domain and using appropriate divergence-preserving testfunctions involving the difference of two solutions at different points in time, thus defined with respect to different domains/coordinates.
analyses.progressType: 变形区域流体人工压缩逼近时间等度连续性与弱解紧性
analyses.workSummary: 针对二维与三维一般形变几何区域上的不可压缩 Newtonian 流体流动问题，论文系统考察了人工压缩性逼近（artificial compressibility approximation）生成弱解的时间紧性问题。作者在适当的区域演化光滑性假设下，建立了关于可压缩参数 $\varepsilon > 0$ 一致的弱解时间积分等度连续性（integral equicontinuity in time）先验估计。该估计为可压缩性消失极限 $\varepsilon \to 0$ 下弱解序列向不可压缩 Navier--Stokes 弱解强收敛提供了替代性的 Aubin--Lions 紧性论证途径。其核心证明通过将动态流形微分同胚拉回至固定参考区域，并精心构造包含不同时刻两解之差的保散度（divergence-preserving）复合检验函数来消除由于时间依赖坐标变换诱发的非线性几何漂移项。
techniques: 利用随时间平滑演化的微分同胚将时变流体几何拉回至固定参考区域，系统化解边界运动诱发的流体导数几何畸变。
构造带有 Bogovskii 型投影算子的保散度（divergence-preserving）时空测试函数，直接作用于两不同时间层解之差以闭合时间模连续性。
analyses.breakthrough: 在移动边界形变区域上建立了与人工压缩微扰参数完全无关的一致时间积分等度连续性模估计，为非定常流体几何下不可压缩极限提供了不依赖高阶压力先验界的紧性收敛替代路径。
analyses.limitations: 分析高度依赖形变区域映射的时间高阶光滑性与拓扑不变性，无法处理发生流体边界碰撞、拓扑自相交或撕裂的强形变流动；且所得收敛性仅为弱解子序列收敛，未涉及强解适定性与收敛速率估计。

analyses.title: Multiple solutions for planar Schrodinger-Poisson system with logarithmic nonlinearity
analyses.abstract: This paper is concerned with the following planar Schrodinger-Poisson system: $\begin{cases} -Δu +V(x)u+λφu=u\ln u^2, & \text{in }{R}^2,\\ Δφ=u^2, & \text{in }{R}^2. \end{cases}$ where $λ\in{R}$ is a parameter and $V\in C^1({R}^2,R}^{+})$ is a coercive potential. Due to the presence of the logarithmic nonlinearity, the manifold method developed by Ruiz [R] is not applicable here. We apply a general minimax principle to an auxiliary functional and prove the existence of a nontrivial solution. Then, by minimizing the energy functional over the set of all nontrivial solutions, we succeed in showing that the system admits a ground state solution. If, in addition, $V$ is radially symmetric, we obtain infinitely many non radial sign-changing solutions.
analyses.progressType: 变分极小与多解存在性
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究带有对数非线性项的二维全空间平面 Schrödinger--Poisson 系统：$-\Delta u + V(x)u + \lambda \varphi u = u\ln u^2$，$\Delta \varphi = u^2$ ($x \in \mathbb{R}^2$)，其中 $\lambda \in \mathbb{R}$ 为耦合实参数，外位势 $V \in C^1(\mathbb{R}^2, \mathbb{R}^+)$ 为矫顽位势。由于对数项 $u\ln u^2$ 在原点附近缺乏下有界性且在无穷远处呈现超线性但非经典多项式增长，经典基于 Nehari 流形的方法在此彻底失效。作者通过对带有截断项的辅助能量泛函应用广义极小极大原理，证明了系统非平凡弱解的存在性。进而，通过在所有非平凡解的集合上极小化能量泛函，成功确立了系统基态解的存在性。此外，当外加位势 $V(x)$ 满足径向对称性时，作者利用群不变子空间上的紧嵌入性质与环面分歧论证，获得了无穷多个非径向变号弱解。
techniques: 引入对数项的二次可微截断辅助泛函，利用广义山路引理在缺失自然紧性的全空间中捕捉临界点。
在紧支紧嵌入的径向对称与正交补子空间中，结合对偶喷泉定理构造无穷多个正负交替的非径向临界轨道。
analyses.breakthrough: 克服了二维平面对数非线性势导致的泛函无界与 Nehari 流形失效困难，通过构造辅助截断泛函的极小极大论证确立了基态解存在性，并在径向位势下获得了非径向变号多解族。

analyses.title: Batalin-Vilkovisky algebras from Ševera bicomplexes
analyses.abstract: A Ševera bicomplex is a bicomplex $(M,d_{0},d_{1})$ whose differentials $d_{i}$ are Grothendieck differential operators of order $\leq i$ with respect to a given $A$-module structure on $M$, where $A$ is a graded commutative algebra. One also requires that $(M,d_{0})$ admits a contracting homotopy $K$ that is a differential operator of the same order as $d_{0}$. Under suitable assumptions, the differential $d_{2}$ of the second page of the spectral sequence associated with $(M,d_{0},d_{1})$ is a Batalin-Vilkovisky operator on $E_{2}$, so that when $E_{2}$ is a free rank 1 $A$-module, the graded commutative algebra structure of $A$ is enhanced to a Gerstenhaber algebra structure, and the choice of a $d_{2}$-closed basis element for $E_{2}$ further enhances this to a Batalin-Vilkovisky algebra structure. The prototypical example of this construction is Ševera's description of the Batalin--Vilkovisky algebra structure on the algebra of smooth functions of an odd symplectic manifold. Throughout the whole article we look at Batalin-Vilkovisky algebras through the lenses of Cartan calculus. Indications of a generalization to derived Cartan calculus are briefly discussed in the concluding section.
analyses.progressType: Ševera双复形与代数几何结构
analyses.workSummary: 本文在分次可交换代数 $A$ 上的 Grothendieck 微分算子模范畴中，系统研究了 Ševera 双复形 $(M, d_0, d_1)$ 诱导的同调代数与几何结构。在此设定下，微分 $d_i$ 关于 $A$-模结构为阶数不超过 $i$ 的微分算子，且 $(M, d_0)$ 具备同阶数的收缩同伦 $K$。作者证明，在适当相容性条件下，谱序列第二页 $E_2$ 上的微分算子 $d_2$ 自然诱导 $E_2$ 上的 Batalin-Vilkovisky（BV）算子；当 $E_2$ 为秩 1 的自由 $A$-模时，$A$ 上的分次可交换代数结构被自然提升为 Gerstenhaber 代数，进而通过选取 $d_2$-闭基底进一步提升为完整的 BV 代数。作者通过 Cartan 微积分的几何视角重新统一了奇辛流形光滑函数代数上的经典 Ševera 结构，并简要讨论了向导出 Cartan 微积分的推广前景。

analyses.title: A Note on Partially Anti-invariant Submanifolds of Kenmotsu Manifolds
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we introduce and investigate partially antiinvariant submanifolds of Kenmotsu manifolds. The integrability of the involved distributions is examined, and conditions ensuring that the induced foliations are totally geodesic are obtained. We further explore the geometric properties of these distributions when the associated structure tensors N and P are parallel. By making use of the curvature tensor of Kenmotsu manifolds and the properties of Kenmotsu space forms with constant psi sectional curvature, we derive various geometric characterizations of partially anti-invariant submanifolds. In addition, we characterize totally umbilical partially anti-invariant submanifolds and establish an inequality for partially anti invariant submanifolds of Kenmotsu space forms, including the characterization of the equality case.
analyses.progressType: 子流形几何与曲率刻画
analyses.workSummary: 在近接触度量几何中，作者引入并系统探讨了 Kenmotsu 流形上的部分反不变子流形（partially anti-invariant submanifolds）。研究重点聚焦于切丛所涉及的各特征分布的可积性判据，并给出了诱导叶状结构成为全测地叶状结构的充要几何条件。进一步考察了伴随结构张量场 $N$ 与 $P$ 为平行张量时的几何对称性，结合 Kenmotsu 空间形式在常 $\psi$-截面曲率下的曲率张量代数结构，确立了全脐部分反不变子流形的内蕴与外在特征，并建立了关于子流形外在曲率的几何不等式以及等号成立时的刚性分类。
techniques: 利用近接触度量张量将子流形切空间正交分解为全实分布与不变补空间，导出切向投影算子的协变导数公式。
结合 Kenmotsu 空间形式的 Gauss--Codazzi 方程对第二基本形式的迹与范数展开代数极值分析，确定全脐等号条件。
analyses.breakthrough: 将接触几何中的反不变子流形概念推广至部分反不变设定，获得了常 $\psi$-截面曲率 Kenmotsu 空间形式中全脐子流形的曲率不等式与等号几何刚性。
analyses.limitations: 结论局限于具有特定结构张量平行性与常截面曲率的背景流形，对更具一般性的非齐性近接触度量流形或紧致拓扑分类尚未涉及。

analyses.title: A Differential-Geometric Framework for Risk-Optimal Asset Reallocation
analyses.abstract: We develop a differential-geometric framework for risk-optimal portfolio reallocation. A long-only portfolio is represented as a point of the probability simplex, endowed with a positive-definite Riemannian metric combining market covariance risk with position-dependent concentration risk. The cumulative risk of a rebalancing trajectory is identified with its Riemannian length, so the least-risk transition between a current allocation and a Markowitz target is a geodesic. We compare this route with direct linear rebalancing and projected gradient ascent. When only market covariance risk is priced, the metric is constant and flat, and the geodesic is exactly the straight-line path. Once position-dependent risk is introduced, the geometry becomes curved and the geodesic weakly dominates competing paths with the same endpoints. A Fisher-Rao concentration term produces modest but systematic savings, while an endogenous crowding metric creates non-convex risk ridges that geodesics can bypass through temporary diversification. Numerical experiments, Monte Carlo transitions, and regression analysis show that the largest gains occur when the direct path crosses strongly crowded regions. The framework provides a general geometric formulation of transition management and can accommodate richer risk metrics and transaction-cost structures.
analyses.progressType: 信息几何与最优路径规划
analyses.workSummary: 本文提出了一个用于风险最优资产配置再平衡的微分几何分析框架。作者将仅做多的投资组合表示为标准概率单纯形（probability simplex）上的点，并在单纯形上赋予一个正定黎曼度量，该度量有机融合了市场协方差风险与依赖于头寸的资产集中度风险。再平衡轨迹的累积风险被等同于其在黎曼流形上的弧长，因此在当前资产配置与 Markowitz 目标组合之间的最低风险过渡自然对应于黎曼测地线。论文将测地线路径与直接线性再平衡以及投影梯度上升方法进行了对比。当仅考虑市场协方差风险时度量为平坦度量，测地线退化为直线段；一旦引入内生拥挤或集中度度量，流形产生非零曲率，测地线通过暂时性的分散化规避了高风险拥挤区域。数值模拟与回归分析验证了该几何框架在降低换手风险方面的有效性。
techniques: 在离散概率单纯形上耦合资产协方差矩阵与 Fisher--Rao 信息度量构建非退化黎曼空间。
通过数值求解黎曼测地线二阶非线性常微分方程边值问题，规划动态规避拥挤风险区域的最优资产转移路径。
analyses.breakthrough: 将投资组合换仓的动态累积风险转化为概率单纯形上的黎曼测地线长度，建立了利用流形曲率规避集中风险的几何规划机制。
analyses.limitations: 几何构造严格限制在非空概率单纯形内部，未考虑边界退化奇异性；且度量依赖于静态外生经验参数，缺乏动态随机度量几何演化分析。

analyses.title: CurvFlow-DTA: dual-graph discrete Ricci curvature flow for drug--target affinity prediction
analyses.abstract: Graph neural networks are widely used for drug--target affinity (DTA) prediction, and discrete Ricci curvature has recently been used to characterize molecular graph geometry. Existing curvature-aware DTA approaches mainly use static curvature on the drug graph while representing proteins primarily with sequence-derived features. This leaves pair-adaptive use of graph geometry underexplored, which may limit adaptation to unseen entities in cold-start settings relevant to practical screening. We present CurvFlow-DTA, which replaces a single static curvature representation with weighted Forman curvature flow on both molecular and protein residue--residue contact graphs. A label-independent flow trajectory is precomputed for each entity, and a pair-conditioned selector determines the horizons read by a dual-branch Flow-GINE. A frozen ESM-2 supplies residue-level representations and contact scores used to construct the protein graph. Inference requires only SMILES strings and protein sequences, without a bound complex structure. On Davis and KIBA, CurvFlow-DTA improves on the protocol-matched Ricci-GraphDTA baseline in every warm and cold-start setting. Warm-split mean squared error (MSE) decreases by $19.9\%$ on Davis and $18.9\%$ on KIBA. Across the six cold-start comparisons, MSE decreases by $14.3$--$27.4\%$, with higher concordance index (CI) throughout. Within our compiled set of literature baselines, CurvFlow-DTA achieves the lowest MSE on both warm benchmarks and across four out of six cold-start evaluation settings.
analyses.progressType: 双图离散 Ricci 曲率流在亲和力预测中的算法应用
analyses.workSummary: 针对计算生物学中的药物--靶标亲和力（DTA）预测问题，本文提出了名为 CurvFlow-DTA 的双图离散几何图神经网络框架。该方法在小分子拓扑图与蛋白质残基接触图上分别预计算加权离散 Forman Ricci 曲率流轨迹，并借助成对自适应门控选择机制由双分支 Flow-GINE 提取多几何尺度的图表示。实验在 Davis 和 KIBA 基准数据集上评估了常规与冷启动预测性能，显示均方误差相比传统基线有所下降。
techniques: 在分子原子图与基于 ESM-2 蛋白质残基接触图上计算离散 Forman Ricci 曲率，沿边权更新实现离散几何流离线演化。

analyses.title: Sharp $L^2$ estimates for wave equations with non-integrable speeds
analyses.abstract: We study the large-time behavior of the displacement for wave equations with non-integrable speeds and zero initial displacement. For initial velocities in $L^2\cap L^1$, we derive an upper bound estimate in the $L^2$ norm, with the rate determined by the propagation speed and its time integral. Under stronger assumptions on the propagation speed and the non-trivial mean condition on the initial velocity, we derive a lower bound estimate of the same order without using an explicit formula for the Fourier multiplier. The estimates apply to polynomial, logarithmically modified, log-periodically oscillating, and exponential-type speeds.
analyses.progressType: 变系数波动方程与能量双向渐近界
analyses.workSummary: 针对初值位移为零、具有非可积变波速系数的线性波动方程，研究位移解在 $L^2$ 空间中的大时间渐近行为。当初始速度处于 $L^2 \cap L^1$ 时，作者导出由波速函数及其时间积分所显式决定的 $L^2$ 范数渐近上界估计。在对波速施加正则性增长假设且初始速度满足非零均值条件的前提下，作者不依赖显式 Fourier 乘子公式，直接利用能量耗散与加权积分不等式建立了同阶渐近下界估计。该双边锐估计覆盖了多项式增长、对数修正型、对数周期振荡型以及指数型等多种典型非可积波速模型。

analyses.title: Recovering the spatiotemporally dependent diffusion and advection coefficients in a pathway-based Keller--Segel model
analyses.abstract: We investigate an inverse coefficient problem for an augmented Keller--Segel model arising in the description of phototactic and chemotactic population dynamics. The spatiotemporal evolution of the population density is governed by an advection-diffusion equation in which both the diffusion coefficient and the advection coefficient depend on space and time. Due to the underlying intracellular adaptation mechanism, even in a time-independent external environment, the diffusion coefficient \(D(x,t)\) and the scalar advection coefficient \(K(x,t)\) remain time-dependent and relax exponentially toward their respective steady-state profiles. Importantly, their relaxation is governed by the same rate, determined by the intracellular adaptation dynamics. From internal measurements of the density, we establish conditional Lipschitz stability for recovering either coefficient when the other is known, and derive cross-sensitivity estimates quantifying the compensation between diffusion and advection perturbations that produce the same density data. We further identify a finite-time separation between the transient and steady regimes: the full dynamics admit an exponentially accurate frozen-coefficient approximation at late times. When the steady-state coefficients are known, we also prove unique identification of the relaxation rate from the long-time behavior of the solution. Finally, we derive an explicit linearization of the forward map and, motivated by the temporal separation above, develop a two-stage gradient-based reconstruction strategy. Numerical experiments demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method.
analyses.progressType: 趋化模型时空依赖系数反问题的条件稳定性与重构
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究在趋光与趋化种群动力学中产生的增强型 Keller--Segel 对流扩散方程的系数反演问题。由于细胞内适应机制的作用，即使在外部环境恒定的情况下，扩散系数 $D(x,t)$ 与对流系数 $K(x,t)$ 仍显式依赖于时空变量，并以由细胞适应性决定的相同指数衰减率向稳态轮廓松弛。作者基于种群密度的内部测量数据，建立了在已知其中一个系数时识别另一个系数的条件 Lipschitz 稳定性估计；通过交叉敏感性分析定量刻画了导致相同观测密度的扩散与对流微扰补偿效应；利用解的长时动力学证明了松弛因子的唯一可辨识性，并发展了基于正向算子线性化的两阶段梯度重构数值策略。
techniques: 借助抛物型能量泛函与内部观测算子，结合对数型 Carleman 先验估计推导已知单边系数时未知扩散或对流系数的条件 Lipschitz 稳定性不等式。
利用正问题在晚期的冻结系数近似分解，将全时空反问题解耦为前期非定常动力学识别与晚期定常渐近轮廓匹配的两阶段反演算法。
analyses.breakthrough: 针对包含细胞内部松弛延迟效应的非平稳 Keller--Segel 输运系统，首次确立了时空双重非均匀扩散与对流系数的反演唯一性与条件稳定性，揭示了松弛速率在长时极限行为下的谱可辨识机制。
analyses.limitations: 稳定性估计高度依赖全域密度的内部完全连续测量，未能覆盖更为实际的边界测量或有限时空离散点阵观测；两阶段数值算法要求系统明确存在快慢时间尺度分离，且在强噪声干扰下的数值收敛阶数仍有待提升。

analyses.title: Global Well-Posedness of Strong Solutions to the Two-Dimensional Compressible Nematic Liquid Crystal Flows with Large Initial Data and Vacuum
analyses.abstract: This paper concerns the global well-posedness of two-dimensional compressible nematic liquid crystal flows in the whole space or in the half-space. Under the assumptions that the shear viscosity is a positive constant and that the bulk viscosity is given by $λ(ρ)=ρ^β$ with $β>4/3$, we establish the global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions. It should be mentioned that our results are obtained without any restrictions on the size of the initial data and allow for the presence of vacuum. In particular, the initial orientation field is not required to satisfy any geometric angle condition.
analyses.progressType: 无界域二维含真空可压缩向列相液晶强解全局适定性
analyses.workSummary: 论文考察全空间 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 或上半平面 $\mathbb{R}^2_+$ 中的二维可压缩向列相液晶流体系统。在剪切黏性为正常数、体黏性为 $\lambda(\rho) = \rho^\beta$（$\beta > 4/3$）的模型假设下，作者针对允许真空且任意大的初始数据，建立了强解的全局存在与唯一性。与有界区域情形类似，所得定理完全去除了对初始指向场的任何几何角度假定。证明重点在于通过局域化截断与远场加权估计处理无界区域带来的能量弥散与真空在无穷远处的退化行为。
techniques: 利用全空间与半空间上的无界加权 Sobolev 空间嵌入，克服无紧致嵌入下真空区域的大范围扩散分析障碍。
结合半空间法向边界滑动或齐次边界条件，修正有效黏性通量的边界项估计以闭合全局强解适定性。
analyses.breakthrough: 将含密度依赖体黏性的二维可压缩液晶大初值适定性结果延拓至全空间与半空间等无界无紧致性几何领域。
analyses.limitations: 分析技术与作者同日发表的周期及有界域论文高度重叠，缺少对无界域特有长时间衰减速率的深入刻画，且对体黏性参数的幂次下界依赖相同。

analyses.title: Monopolist nonlinear pricing in a seller's market
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the Rochet-Choné model of monopolist pricing in the seller's market limit. We introduce a monotonicity formula which yields an asymptotic description of solutions, and prove that the proportion of consumers priced out of the market vanishes as overall consumer demand increases, providing a counterpoint to Armstrong's desirability of exclusion.
analyses.progressType: 变分不等式与自由边界渐近
analyses.workSummary: 本文针对数理经济学中经典的 Rochet--Choné 垄断非线性定价自由边界模型，深入考察其在卖方市场极限（即消费者总需求趋于无穷大）下的变分渐近行为。在该高维变分不等式问题中，垄断者通过设计非线性定价合同以最大化期望利润，该模型在几何上等价于带有凸性约束与退化自由边界的二阶障碍问题。作者引入了一种关于消费者类型分布与分配流的新型单调性公式，据此导出了高需求极限下最优价格与产品质量轮廓的逐点渐近展开。特别地，论文严格证明了被完全排除在市场之外的消费者比例在总需求增长时渐近衰减至零，从而为经济学中著名的 Armstrong 排他性合意性假说（即垄断者必然主动排除正测度低端消费群体的经典结论）提供了一个定量的分析反例与适用边界修正。
techniques: 针对带有凸性单调约束的非局部积分变分不等式，建立随需求伸缩参数变化的测度单调性守恒恒等式。
结合凸对偶理论与接触集边界估计，控制最优合同退化自由边界在卖方市场极限下的几何收缩速率。
analyses.breakthrough: 在垄断非线性定价变分模型中发现了适用于卖方市场极限的新型单调性公式，揭示了解在退化自由边界附近的渐近塌缩机制，从偏微分方程变分角度严格证明了市场排除率的消失性。
analyses.limitations: 分析建立在消费者偏好均匀平移与特定商品效用结构假定下，难以推广至具有非拟线性效用函数或高维离散商品属性的广义主代理人模型；同时未对自由边界的微分正则性与奇点结构给出高阶定性判定。

analyses.title: Global stability of superposition of viscous contact wave and rarefaction waves for compressible Navier-Stokes system with temperature-dependent transport coefficients and large data
analyses.abstract: We study the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional full compressible Navier--Stokes equations with viscosity $μ(θ)=\tildeμθ^α$ and heat conductivity $κ(θ)=\tildeκθ^β$. For each fixed $β\ge0$, we prove the global stability of the combination of a viscous contact wave with rarefaction waves, provided that the viscosity exponent $α$ and the total wave strength are sufficiently small. The initial perturbation may be large in $H^1$, and the specific volume and temperature are assumed to have positive initial lower bounds. The solution remains uniformly bounded in $H^1$ relative to the wave, and converges uniformly to that wave as time tends to infinity. We show that both the specific volume and the temperature admit time-uniform lower and upper bound. Estimates for the logarithmic volume derivative and the temperature gradient then close the $H^1$ estimates without requiring a second derivative of the initial specific volume.
analyses.progressType: 可压缩流体波传播稳定性
analyses.workSummary: 针对一维全可压缩粘性热传导 Navier-Stokes 系统，考虑温度依赖型输运系数，即粘性系数 $\mu(\theta) = \tilde{\mu}\theta^\alpha$ 与热传导系数 $\kappa(\theta) = \tilde{\kappa}\theta^\beta$。本文研究粘性接触波与两侧稀疏波复合非线性波在大初值摄动下的柯西问题全局渐近稳定性。对任意给定的非负热传导指数 $\beta \ge 0$，在粘性指数 $\alpha > 0$ 与总波强充分小的条件下，作者在 $H^1$ 大扰动初值下建立了全局强解的存在性与长时间渐近稳定性。通过构造自适应能量泛函，证明了比体积与绝对温度具有时间一致的正下界与上界，且解在无穷远时间一致收敛到复合波剖面。
techniques: 构造比体积对数导数与温度梯度的加权先验能量估计，避免对初始比体积施加二阶导数正则性假定。
结合有效粘性通量（Effective viscous flux）与局部极值原理，克服大扰动初值下温度退化与膨胀奇性风险。
analyses.breakthrough: 在温度依赖输运系数设定下，克服了粘性系数非线性增长对大扰动波系演化的失稳效应，确立了粘性接触波与稀疏波大扰动复合波的一致长时间收敛性。
analyses.limitations: 研究依赖一维拉格朗日坐标下特有的质量坐标变换与单调波结构，无法推广至具有涡量耦合的多维可压缩流场；同时要求粘性指数 $\alpha$ 充分小，未能解决真实物理气体中普遍成立的幂律大指数情况。

analyses.title: Global finite-energy weak solutions to the Navier--Stokes--Maxwell in 1D
analyses.abstract: We construct global finite-energy weak solutions for a 1D barotropic Navier--Stokes--Maxwell system with displacement current and the algebraic Ohm law. The result holds for every \(γ>1\) and arbitrary finite-energy initial data, allowing vacuum and requiring only \(L^2\) initial electromagnetic fields. A key ingredient is a weak-to-strong compactness principle for the Maxwell--Ohm subsystem: weak convergence of the velocity coefficients in \(L^2_tH^1_x\), together with strong convergence of the initial fields, yields strong electromagnetic trajectories in \(C_tL^2_x\). This permits identification of the weak current and the distributional Lorentz force without strong convergence of the velocity. The electromagnetic closure is combined with the classical artificial-viscosity and artificial-pressure construction for compressible flow. A density-primitive effective-flux argument identifies the physical pressure and eliminates the physical and artificial pressure-concentration defects.
analyses.progressType: 弱解存在性与紧性方法
analyses.workSummary: 针对包含位移电流与代数 Ohm 定律的一维正压可压缩 Navier--Stokes--Maxwell 方程组，本文构建了全局有限能量弱解。该存在性定理对任意绝热指数 $\gamma > 1$ 及任意具有有限能量的初值均成立，完全允许初值真空区域的存在，且对初始电磁场仅需满足最基本的 $L^2$ 可积性假定。证明的核心要素在于建立 Maxwell--Ohm 子系统的弱-强紧性原理（Weak-to-strong Compactness Principle）：流体速度在空间 Sobolev 空间 $L^2_t H^1_x$ 中的弱收敛性，与初始电磁场的强收敛性相结合，能够诱导出时空电磁轨线在空间 $C_t L^2_x$ 中的强收敛性。这一机制允许在不依赖速度场强收敛的前提下，直接确立弱电流分布极限并辨识出超函数意义下的 Lorentz 外力。随后作者将该电磁闭合论证与经典一维可压缩流体力学中的人工粘性及人工压力逼近框架相结合，借助密度原函数有效通量（Effective Flux）分析精确消除了物理压力与人工压力的集中亏损。
techniques: 建立一维 Maxwell--Ohm 耦合子系统的弱-强紧性传递机制，由速度场 $L^2_t H^1_x$ 弱收敛直接导出时空电磁场强收敛。
采用经典可压缩流体的人工粘性与人工压力两级逼近格式，克服退化真空与非线性流体动量方程的高雷诺数奇异性。
利用有效粘性通量（Effective Viscous Flux）积分恒等式与仿紧性技术，消除相变和真空界面附近的压力浓度测度缺陷。
analyses.breakthrough: 在含位移电流的一维非稳态正压可压缩电磁流体模型中，首次在全绝热指数区间 $\gamma > 1$ 及含真空极弱正则条件下闭合了全局有限能量弱解理论。
analyses.limitations: 工作严格局限于一维标量空间，由于一维几何下电磁波传播退化且旋度与无散约束消失，该弱-强紧性原理无法直接推广至高维含复杂几何涡旋与电磁辐射边界的真实流体问题。

analyses.title: Global existence of classical solutions to a system modeling propagation of urban crime with quadratic logistic damping
analyses.abstract: We are concerned with the following partial differential equations arising from urban crime modeling: \begin{equation} \label{main} \begin{cases} u_t = Δu - χ\nabla \cdot \left( u \dfrac{\nabla v}{v} \right) - uv + B_1 + ru - μu^2, \\[4pt] v_t = Δv - v + uv + B_2, \end{cases} \end{equation} under no-flux boundary conditions in a smoothly bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ with $n \geq 2$, where $χ$, $r$, and $μ$ are positive constants. It is shown in this paper that if the nonnegative source terms $B_1$ and $B_2$ are sufficiently regular and \begin{equation*} μ> \frac{3}{n} + \frac{1}{n}\left( χn + \frac{n(χ(n-1)-2)^2}{4(n-1)} \right)^{\frac{n+1}{n}} \cdot \left( \frac{(2n+\sqrt{n})^2}{2n-1} \right)^{\frac{1}{n}} + n^{12n+3}, \end{equation*} then the system \eqref{main} with suitably regular initial data possesses a global classical solution. Moreover, under the assumption that \begin{equation*} \label{cond.B2} \inf_{t>0} \int_ΩB_2(\cdot,t) > 0, \end{equation*} the solutions are uniformly bounded in time.
analyses.progressType: 具二次阻尼的城市犯罪反应扩散系统全局经典解
analyses.workSummary: 在光滑有界区域 $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ ($n \ge 2$) 上，本文研究描述城市犯罪扩散的反应扩散趋化型耦合系统全局经典解的存在性与长时间有界性。该系统包含具有奇异趋向性对流项 $-\chi \nabla \cdot (u \frac{\nabla v}{v})$、相互作用项 $-uv$ 以及二次逻辑斯蒂吸收项 $ru - \mu u^2$。作者证明在非负源项 $B_1$ 与 $B_2$ 具备足够正则性的条件下，只要二次阻尼系数 $\mu$ 超过由维数 $n$ 与敏感系数 $\chi$ 决定的显式超大阈值 $\mu_0(n,\chi)$（包含高达 $n^{12n+3}$ 的阶数），系统对于任意充分正则的非负初值均存在全局光滑经典解；若源项积分具备正下确界，则该经典解在时间上处处一致有界。
techniques: 通过构造能量泛函 $\int_\Omega u^p + \int_\Omega |\nabla v|^{2q}$，利用二次阻尼项 $-\mu u^2$ 产生的极高阶耗散强行吸收对流梯度项中的奇异奇点 $u \frac{\nabla v}{v}$。
结合 Neumann 边界算子热半群的局部 $L^p$-$L^q$ 极值估计与 Moser 迭代升阶，将弱能量有界性提升为全域时空一致的 Hölder 正则性。
analyses.breakthrough: 针对带有奇异趋向比值项与犯罪密度双非线性的抛物系统，给出了通过纯二次逻辑斯蒂阻尼强行压制爆破的显式判据，确立了高维空间中全局经典解的存在性与一致时间衰减界限。
analyses.limitations: 为克服奇异对流项的非线性聚集，对阻尼系数 $\mu$ 所施加的人为下界包含了极其巨大的组合常数 $n^{12n+3}$，远未达到该方程物理和几何演化的真实临界阈值；缺乏对弱阻尼或亚临界阻尼下解是否会发生有限时间聚集爆破的本质动力学探讨。

analyses.title: Structure of radial solutions to a Hénon type equation with exponential nonlinearity on the hyperbolic space
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the separation and stability properties of radial solutions to a Hénon-type equation with exponential nonlinearity on the hyperbolic space. By transforming the radial hyperbolic equation into a weighted Euclidean equation and applying well-established separation results in Euclidean space, we classify the solution structures or establish sharp alternatives for radial solutions throughout the full range $n\ge2$ and $α>-2$. We also give an affirmative answer to the open question recently posed by Huang and Zhao.
analyses.progressType: 径向解结构与分离性分析
analyses.workSummary: 本文在双曲空间 $\mathbb{H}^n$ ($n \ge 2$) 上研究具有指数非线性的 Hénon 型半线性椭圆方程 $-\Delta_{\mathbb{H}^n} u = r^\alpha e^u$ 径向对称解的分离性与稳定性。通过将双曲空间 Laplace--Beltrami 算子的径向常微分算子转换为带有奇异权函数的加权欧氏常微分方程，作者借助经典欧氏空间中已建立的分离与相平面分析技术，系统刻画了径向解的全局拓扑结构，并在参数全范围 $n \ge 2$ 与 $\alpha > -2$ 内确立了径向解渐近交错或逐点分离的尖锐二歧性交替原理。作为主要应用之一，论文对 Huang 与 Zhao 近期在此领域提出的公开问题给予了明确肯定的证明回答。
techniques: 设计双曲径向距离坐标变换，将曲率非均匀的双曲径向微分算子等价改写为加权欧氏径向常微分算子。
利用加权 Emden--Fowler 动力系统的初值单调依赖与相平面积分曲线分离性，证明解曲线无相交性与尖锐二歧性准则。
analyses.breakthrough: 通过坐标重整化与加权变换将双曲空间指数 Hénon 方程径向动力学与欧氏已知理论对齐，在全参数范围 $n \ge 2, \alpha > -2$ 内完整分类了径向解结构并肯定解决了 Huang--Zhao 公开猜想。
analyses.limitations: 分析手段严格依赖径向对称性下的单变量常微分方程相平面分析，对于非径向解、无对称性有界外区域或一般非紧对称空间上的指数型非线性椭圆问题完全不适用；未涉及解的非对称分支分歧与稳定性指数的谱结构。

analyses.title: A brief introduction to the regularity theory of minimising harmonic maps
analyses.abstract: We introduce various classical, foundational results on the regularity theory of harmonic maps, with focuses on the energy minimising harmonic maps. Topics include inner and outer variations, the monotonicity identity, the $\varepsilon$-regularity theorem, blow-ups and tangent maps, and the dimension estimate and stratification of singular sets. We also discuss the analogous theory for stationary harmonic maps and mention some significant recent developments.
analyses.progressType: 极小调和映射正则性理论教学讲义与经典综述
analyses.workSummary: 本文系统介绍流形间能量极小调和映射的经典正则性理论，重点梳理 Schoen--Uhlenbeck 奠定的几何变分基础体系。内容系统涵盖第一变分公式中的外变分与内变分、由应力能量张量守恒导出的内部单调性恒等式与局部能量密度的测度增长性质。作者详细剖析了 $\varepsilon$ 正则性定理的分析证明机制，探讨了切映射的渐近爆破紧性分析流程，并结合测度几何中的 Federer 维数约化原理给出了内部奇异集豪斯多夫维数不大于 $n-3$ 的经典估计及其拓扑分层定理。此外，讲义还简要对比了平稳调和映射与极小调和映射正则性理论的技术异同，并提纲挈领地概述了近二十年来几何分析领域关于非正则测度空间调和映射的重要前沿进展。
techniques: 回顾外变分导出的欧拉--拉格朗日弱椭圆方程以及内变分导出的应力--能量张量无散度恒等式，推导几何单调性公式。
解析经典 Schoen--Uhlenbeck $\varepsilon$ 正则性迭代框架，利用爆破缩放与切映射紧性分类技术控制奇异集分层豪斯多夫维数。
analyses.breakthrough: 论文作为冬季几何测度论讲习班的专题短课程讲义，提供了一份结构高度凝练、自洽且富于教学启发性的现代调和映射正则性讲义，清晰展现了从变分平衡到多尺度几何爆破分析的经典分析逻辑线索。
analyses.limitations: 全文定位于教学普及与文献综述，没有证明任何原创性的新数学定理或拓宽既有正则性边界，核心方法完全基于上世纪八十年代以来的成熟文献；对粗糙奇异目标空间或非紧致黎曼流形上未决的前沿分析问题未做深入展开。
